out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored in bucket without enough sanitizer solution. Observed 100ppm
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CDI new bucket was made 200ppm quat.

out_items.name: Food additives; approved and properly used

violations.title: Approved Food or Color Additive
violations.observation: The following unsafe or unapproved food or color additives is applied to food: Amazon Gueevin eggshell marking ink used to mark empanada shell. Could not find on FDA GRAS list of approved food additives.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from the addition of unsafe or unapproved food or color additives AND unsafe or unapproved levels of approved foods and color additives. CDI cease using additive until proven GRAS. PIC will contact company and get ingredient list. PIC will replace ink with food grade food coloring from Micheals baking section.
